Wall Street Journal :

 THORChain, which handled ~$1B of stolen Bybit funds in 2025 for $12M+ in fees, began moving the Binance loot despite FBI pleas, saying it can't stop transfers   —  Some crypto developers say they can't stop North Korean hackers from laundering stolen funds through their platforms, frustrating law enforcement

prioritas.lead_hu: A THORChain kripto-platform az FBI felszólítása ellenére elindította az ellopott Binance-alapok átutalását, arra hivatkozva, hogy technikailag nem tudja leállítani a tranzakciókat.
